rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for different kinds or a range of things.

example.english: This shop has a wide variety of tea.
example.traditional: 呢間舖有好多種類嘅茶。
example.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 pou3 jau5 hou2 do1 zung2 leoi6 ge3 caa4

rows.note: Use this when variety means changing experiences or features that keep something interesting.

example.english: Changing the dishes often gives us variety at mealtimes.
example.traditional: 餐廳成日轉換菜式，食飯先有變化。
example.jyutping: caan1 teng1 seng4 jat6 zyun2 wun6 coi3 sik1 sik6 faan6 sin1 jau5 bin3 faa3

rows.note: Use this for the abstract quality of diversity, especially in formal or written discussion.

example.english: This report examines the variety within Hong Kong society.
example.traditional: 呢份報告探討香港社會嘅多樣性。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 taam3 tou2 hoeng1 gong2 se5 wui6 ge3 do1 joeng6 sing3
